title: The Magic of Connection
shortDescription: Bringing the Temperance Woods Together — teaching cognition and connection through gentle, reflective coloring pages.
fullDescription: Bringing the Temperance Woods Together -- teaching cognition and connection through gentle, reflective coloring pages. Follow a small cast of forest characters as they navigate misunderstandings, practice listening, and find their way back to each other, one page at a time -- a quiet, screen-free way to talk about feelings, friendship, and what it really means to reconnect.
